Batch: JoeWare SecData, SecTok and SeInteractiveLogonRight publisher source review

Scope.AdFindAcceptance: Excluded from selected acceptance batches; no AdFind action in this review.

Findings: SecData queries Active Directory user/computer security attributes and emits CSV; fields include account names/DNs, bad-password and lockout data, last logon, password timestamps, account expiry and decoded userAccountControl flags.
Publisher page version 2.03.0 dated 2002-08-19; platform claims are Windows 2000, Server 2003 and XP against AD.
Publisher says returned data depends on directory permissions and source code is unavailable.
SecTok displays the current process token user SID/name and group SIDs/names; page version 1.00.00 dated 2001-11-11.
Publisher historical platform claims end at Windows XP; no special security requirement is listed and source code is unavailable.
SeInteractiveLogonRight sets the local interactive-logon user right for a specified identity and clears the corresponding deny-interactive-logon right; page version 0.10.00 dated 2001-09-20.

Publisher platform claims end at Windows XP and source code is unavailable. The page says no special requirements; the rights mutation still requires isolated state-changing acceptance and exact recovery evidence.
